HeyGen Voice HeyGen Voice is a text-to-speech model from HeyGen. It comes with 10 default voices, or bring your own HeyGen key to use voice clones from your own account. It streams... speech

HeyGen Voice Turbo HeyGen Voice Turbo is a lower-latency version of HeyGen Voice, HeyGen's text-to-speech model. It has the same 10 default voices, or bring your own HeyGen key to use voice clones... speech
